verdict.rationale: Official docs confirm Logseq Sync exists (up to 10 graphs across Desktop/Android/iOS) and explicitly state graphs are end-to-end encrypted [logseq-docs-10][logseq-docs-28]. However, hands-on community reports contradict reliability: sync was gated behind a paid sponsor tier and 'has enough bugs that I wouldn't rely on it yet' [logseq-comm-2], and another user reports 'early attempts at syncing didn't work well... we saw nothing for years' despite paying to support it [logseq-comm-8]. Missing for 10: independent verification of encryption implementation/audit, resolved bug reports, and confirmation sync is stable and fully rolled out (not still gated/buggy).
